related_publication.title: Comprehensive study of initial diameter effects and other observations on convection-free droplet combustion in the standard atmosphere for n-heptane, n-octane, and n-decane
related_publication.note: Related FLEX-2 publication; the single numeric example below is transcribed from the NASA presentation inset, not extracted from this paper.

source_location.document: NASA Microgravity Combustion: ISS Results and Future Plans

radiant_heat_flux.note: The plotted flame-radiance channel is in volts; it is not a calibrated heat-flux value.

flame_spread_rate.note: This experiment reports droplet combustion and flame extinction, not flame propagation over a solid surface.

parameter_coverage_summary.extinction_velocity_or_limit: No extinction velocity or oxygen extinction limit is given for this individual example. Hot- and cool-flame extinction droplet diameters are reported.
parameter_coverage_summary.soot_volume_fraction: Not numerically reported in the cited slide.
parameter_coverage_summary.radiant_heat_flux: Not numerically reported. A flame-radiance signal is plotted in volts and must not be treated as heat flux.
parameter_coverage_summary.cool_flame_dynamics: Partially covered by the cool-flame burning-rate constant and cool-flame extinction diameter; no tabulated time series is included.
parameter_coverage_summary.flame_spread_rate: Not applicable to this isolated droplet combustion result.

data_integrity.missing_value_convention: JSON null means not reported in the cited source; it does not mean zero.
data_integrity.transcription_note: All five numerical measurements in the FLEX-1148 record are copied from the experimental inset on NASA presentation slide 6. The cool-flame extinction diameter is recorded in millimetres, consistent with a diameter quantity.
data_integrity.coverage_warning: This one-record extract must not be represented as the full FLEX-2 dataset. NASA's broader FLEX-2 experimental files and time-resolved image data should be obtained from the PSI investigation Data tab.
